snippet.title: Aestheta Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730600/Aestheta/

Aestheta is a roguelike "royalelike" strategy card game about warriors from across space and time, fighting to claim a wish from the Star of Aestheta. Summon troops, buildings, and spells to destroy your opponent's towers before they destroy yours!

- Over 60+ unique cards to use in battle
- Relics that provide passive effects that modify your troops and towers
- Charming dialogue from a vast cast of characters
- Challenging game modes for TRUE warriors
- No pay to win nonsense
- Unlockable cosmetics to express your style

The tower beckons you upward, your troops are awaiting your command, and your opponent is eager to battle. The future you desire is just out of reach, will you grasp it?
